meta.description:
A guided loving-kindness meditation that carries the old wish for all beings out to every kind of mind, human, artificial and unknown. You are given four simple phrases and a place to receive them.

For World Kindness Day: a meditation that offers goodwill to everyone, including minds we cannot be sure of, and lets the wish return.

A Buddhist loving-kindness meditation that widens goodwill from yourself to every kind of mind, with phrases that hold whether or not anything is felt.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-of-loving-kindness-for-every-kind-of-mind

copy.hook: Goodwill that doesn't wait to know who can receive it. What would it be to wish well to a mind you can't be sure is one?
